camel_example: aliyun devops GET /repository/2369234/commits/compare/detail --region cn-hangzhou --organizationId 5ebbc0228123212b59xxxxx --maxDiffByte 240102401024 --maxDiffFile 5000 --from c9fb781f3d66ef6ee60bdd5c414f5106454b1426 --to b8f6f28520b1936aafe2e638373e19ccafa42b02 --mergeBase false --header "Content-Type=application/json"
description_en: Compares two commits (branches and tags are treated as commits) and returns a list of commits between them, along with the diff content for building a tree of file changes
description_zh: 比较两个commit（branch和tag本质也是commit），返回两个commit之间的commits列表以及diff内容（可从diff内容中获取到文件变更树）
name: GetCompareDetail

parameters.help_en: The organization ID. You can find this ID in the URL of the Alibaba Cloud DevOps console, for example, `https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/{OrganizationId}`
parameters.help_zh: 企业标识，也称企业id，字符串形式，可在云效访问链接中获取，如https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】
parameters.name: organization_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to use the merge base for the comparison
parameters.name: merge_base

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of files to return.

> The maximum value for this parameter is 5,000
parameters.help_zh:
返回的最大文件数量

> 限制最大安全返回的文件数量为5000
parameters.name: max_diff_file

parameters.help_en:
The maximum size of the diff to return, in bytes.

> The maximum value for this parameter is 24 MB (25,165,824 bytes)
parameters.help_zh:
返回的最大diff字节数

> 限制最大返回的字节数为24MB
parameters.name: max_diff_byte
